fact: When a diagnostic export (e.g. C_qn_fast_orig, rob_loc_fast_orig) is removed after its optimization phase, remove all skip_if_not(exists('export_name')) test blocks at the same commit.
why: Tests guarded by a missing export become permanently-skipped dead code that accumulates as CI SKIP noise and obscures real skip signals. The removal commit is the right moment — context is fresh and the tests can never run again.

fact: To exclude dev-tooling dirs (.beads/, .metaswarm/, .tldr/) from R packages: (1) add entries to .Rbuildignore so they are excluded from the build tarball; (2) run git rm --cached -r <dir> for any dir that was committed before the .gitignore entry existed.
why: .Rbuildignore fixes R CMD check NOTEs about hidden/non-standard files by keeping them out of the tarball. git rm --cached is separately needed to stop git tracking files that predate their .gitignore entry — both steps are required.
